questions.question: Describe the role of the Application Framework in Android.
questions.solution_html:
• Provides high-level services to application developers
  • Acts as a bridge between applications and hardware/system
  • Offers reusable components like
  •  Activity Manager (manages app lifecycle)
  •  Window Manager (handles UI)
  •  Content Providers (data sharing)
  •  Resource Manager (access to resources)
  • Enables code reuse and faster development
  • Ensures consistency and standardization across apps
  • Upload Application
  •  Upload signed APK/AAB file
  •  Provide content rating and target audience
questions.final_answer:  Provide content rating and target audience
questions.source_exam: MGU-UGP (HONOURS) 2024 Admission Regular Exam Sem 4, March 2026

questions.question: Explain the role of HTTP and JSON in Android web service communication.
questions.solution_html:
• HTTP (HyperText Transfer Protocol)
  •  Used for communication between client (Android app) and server
  •  Supports request methods like GET, POST, PUT, DELETE
  • JSON (JavaScript Object Notation)
  •  Lightweight data format for data exchange
  •  Easy to parse and generate
  • Combined Role
  •  HTTP sends requests → server responds with JSON data
  •  Enables data transfer, API communication, and dynamic content
  • loading
  • Publish the App
  •  Submit for review by Google
  •  After approval, app becomes available on Play Store
questions.final_answer:  After approval, app becomes available on Play Store

questions.question: Describe the 'Testing' phase and the various types of testing involved.
questions.solution_html:
• Testing Phase
  •  Ensures application is free from errors and meets requirements
  •  Performed before deployment
  • Types of Testing
  •  Unit Testing – Tests individual components
  •  Integration Testing – Tests combined modules
  •  System Testing – Tests entire application
  •  User Acceptance Testing (UAT) – Validates user requirements
  •  Performance Testing – Checks speed and responsiveness
  • Post-Release Maintenance
  •  Monitor feedback and reviews
  •  Fix bugs and release updates
  •  Add new features
  • Publishing involves preparation, signing, testing, and deployment, ensuring
  • quality and security.

questions.question: Differentiate between Content Provider and SQLite database.
questions.solution_html:
• Aspect Content Provider SQLite Database
  • Purpose Data sharing between apps Local data storage
  • Access Accessible by multiple apps Restricted to one app
  • Interface Uses URI (Uniform Resource Identifier) Uses SQL queries
  • Security Controlled access permissions Internal app use
  • Usage Inter-app communication Data storage within app

questions.question: Discuss the concept and importance of Fragments in Android applications.
questions.solution_html:

  •  Fragment is a reusable UI component within an activity
  •  Has its own lifecycle and layout
  • Importance

  •  Supports multi-pane layouts (tablets, large screens)
  •  Improves code reusability
  •  Allows dynamic UI changes at runtime
  •  Enhances user experience and flexibility
